wa_beetle_bailey_slab.blurb: A granite slab in the Lower Lump area at Index, in the Skykomish Valley, reached with a short walk from town. About 38 climbs in our catalog, split between bolted sport lines and trad, with a few going multi-pitch. Grades start around 5.6 and run to 5.12, but most sit in the 5.10 to 5.11 range, so it suits intermediate and stronger climbers; the lower grades are better found on neighbouring walls. Large maples shade the base, which makes it pleasant on hot days, though the slab can stay wet after rain. The upper part of the slab sits on land bought for public ownership by climbing groups.
wa_beetle_bailey_slab.approach: Park at the turnout just beyond the Lower Town Wall lot, cross the railroad tracks, and follow the trail down and to the left to the wall. The large rock blob called the Wart on the right is an easy landmark.

wa_private_idaho.blurb: A cliff of roughly 100 feet in the forest above the town of Index, part of the Lookout Point area. Our catalog lists about 37 climbs, mostly trad crack lines with some sport routes and a couple of top-ropes, from 5.7 up to 5.13 with the bulk at 5.10 and 5.11. It is a good stop for moderate cracks and for easier climbs than most Index walls offer, and it sees far fewer people than the Lower Town Wall. The left side is shady at the base. Cross the railroad tracks on the way in, and many lines can be top-roped by scrambling around the right side.
wa_private_idaho.approach: Leave the car in town, walk to the railroad crossing, and follow the tracks along the wall side. Partway around the bend, take the trail on the right to a small wooden bridge, then climb through forest to a crest and past the Midnite boulder. After the T-junction, the right-hand trail runs below the wall and reaches the routes.

_expect.name: Phun Rock Main Wall & Sunbug Slab

wa_f_phun_rock_main_wall_sunbug_slab.blurb: The main cliffs at Fun Rock, a bolted sport area on Lost River Road near Mazama in the Methow Valley. Our catalog has about 37 climbs here, nearly all sport, from around 5.5 to 5.12, with a good cluster of 5.10 to 5.11. The rock is meta-volcanic, with roofs and plenty of slabs. The Main Wall holds the best-known hard line, while Sunbug Slab, higher up and farthest right, has a few easier lines. Sun hits midday and afternoon but trees give shade. Everything starts from one parking lot, so it is a convenient half day. Camping or sleeping in vehicles in the lot or along the paved road is not allowed.
wa_f_phun_rock_main_wall_sunbug_slab.parking_note: Use the large Fun Rock lot on the right side of Lost River Road, roughly 1.4 to 1.5 miles northwest of the Mazama General Store. Do not camp or sleep in your vehicle there.
wa_f_phun_rock_main_wall_sunbug_slab.approach: From the trailhead, follow the main trail east alongside the road. You pass a 5.12a just before the Main Wall. Keep climbing up rock steps past a bulge to reach Sunbug Slab, the upper right-hand cliff.
